steps.name: check-deps
steps.description: Verify t0024 and t0065 dependencies are completed and assets are available.

steps.name: init-folders
steps.description: Initialize the standard task folder structure.

steps.name: research-code
steps.description: Survey t0024 code (build_dsgc_cell, ar2_noise, run_tuning_curve) to identify exact reusable helpers and the per-synapse silencing knobs (Exp2Syn weight, NetCon weight[0], HHst_noiseless gnabar/gkbar).

steps.name: planning
steps.description: Write plan/plan.md detailing the 6-cell x 20-trial protocol, file layout, and per-mode override sequencing on the de Rosenroll substrate.

steps.name: implementation
steps.description: Implement code/run_protocol.py + plotting; run the 120-trial sweep (~2h10m) and emit voltage_traces CSV plus PNGs (including cross-model t0065 vs t0066 IPSP comparison).

steps.name: results
steps.description: Write results_summary.md, results_detailed.md (spec_version 2 with all mandatory sections), metrics.json, costs.json, remote_machines_used.json with embedded plots.

steps.name: suggestions
steps.description: Author suggestions.json with follow-up tasks driven by the de Rosenroll EPSP/IPSP decomposition findings and the cross-model comparison.

steps.name: reporting
steps.description: Run all verificators, mark task completed, push branch, open PR, merge.
